description: When is the next JOLTS (Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey) release? Returns the next release date and time in US Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default) and its reference month; note JOLTS usually comes out at 10:00 ET, not the 08:30 ET of the jobs report. Source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics JOLTS schedule page, which sometimes lists only the next one or two dates. Gives dates only, not the job openings figures. (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_jolts_release
